newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $4.5 bln for the week of April 7.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $4.5 bln for the week of April 7.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of April 7 are expected to total $4.5 billion in 120 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $3.1 billion in 49 sales, with a $900 million New York City deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 71 sales totaling $1.4 billion are on the schedule, a $307 million Georgia deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $388 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week, depending on market conditions.
